conclusions: FP32 FFBP Graph and fusion have a substantial observed timing effect, but the trial is not uniformly steady-state.
Small FP64/mixed timing deltas and FP32 direct chunk rankings are insufficiently stable to rank confidently.

FP32 FFBP stored metrics match exactly across variants; FP64/mixed fused metrics differ from original by very small amounts. Within each variant Graph and ordinary execution metrics match. Full image bitwise equality was not measured.
All current FFBP variants retain about 3.29-3.50% total complex error on this ROI; pure execution changes do not solve the quality gap.
The phase32 probe comparison changes precision, chunk size and Graph together; cannot isolate FP32 trigonometry without same-chunk same-Graph mixed control.
